name: horka-research-plan
description: Right model, right effort, right moment: multi-agent research that spends tokens where judgement matters. The most capable model orchestrates and judges, the expert tier researches, the generalist tier validates and counts, each at its own effort level, instead of every subagent inheriting the session's top model. Ends in a sourced action plan: reality check (prod / develop / open PRs), personas and real-demand probe first, independent validators that open every URL, antagonist critic, one doc-style HTML page, then a retrospective that rewrites a lessons file read by the next run. No number without a source, no agent grading its own work.
